title: Nelson
description:
Darth Vader has an audience with the holographic Emperor in this memorable scene from THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK. "l think that STAR WARS is great because it has everything you want to see in a movie," observes Nelson (De Castro). "The film has incredible-looking villains, heroes, a love story, adventure, humor, special effects...no wonder we all went nuts when we first saw it!" Nelson's first gig in the comics business was a fully-painted cover for GHOST RIDER $18 (Marvel). Other work includes a couple of ROBOCOP projects for Dark Horse (the ROBOCOP 3 movie adaptation and PRIME SUSPECT), a JURASSIC PARK painted card for Topps and his own creation, THE EUDAEMON, for Dark Horse/Manta Comics.
